_doc: Size + comment ratchet. New files must stay under maxNewFileLines. Listed files must not grow. Comment share per directory must not rise. Lower these numbers as the refactor lands; never raise one without a note in 'exceptions'.
_dirsNote: Folder fan-out ratchet. A module and its .d.ts count once. These folders predate the 12-file cap; each may shrink, never grow, and a new folder over the cap is split rather than recorded here.
_commentPctNote: browser/js holds only the boot shims now (index.js, prePaintTheme.js, pwa.js) plus the utils barrel — utils.js's ~480 lines of code moved to browser/js/utils/, so the same prose is a bigger share of a much smaller directory. Comment VOLUME did not rise.
_behaviouralPinNote: strokeGrowth.test.js 298 → 311: the renderer's flown-geometry pin was five readFileSync regexes; it now drives drawLine over a recording context (tests/helpers/recordingCtx.js) so renderer.js can be split. A behavioural pin costs lines a source regex does not.
_testCssImportNote: components.css/animations.css were split into css/components/ and css/animations/; the tests that assert on a whole stylesheet each gained ONE import of tests/helpers/css.js. That +1 is the only growth recorded here.

_notes.browser/js/core/drawingApp.d.ts: 397 and shaped by its module: 92 lines are the type vocabulary 87 other shape files import through './drawingApp.js', and the rest is ONE `export declare class DrawingApp` mirroring a 601-line class whose own floor is pinned by seven test files reading its source text. A class declaration cannot be split, so this follows drawingApp.js down rather than separately.
_notes.commentPct: commentPct was re-measured when the walker began counting .d.ts files: a shape file is mostly declarations with a documenting line above each, so every directory holding one reads a few points higher. No prose was added — the measured scope grew. These are the new floors.
_notes.browser/js/console/stencilApi.d.ts: 357 and single-file on purpose: vscode-extension/tools/genTypings.mjs reads THIS file as its one SOURCE to generate the shipped vscode-extension/typings/stencil.d.ts, and vscode-extension/tests/apiVocabulary.test.js pins the vocabulary's presence here. Splitting the type vocabulary out silently stripped it from the generated typings, so the facade and its vocabulary stay together.
